privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How the HIV Pension Portal protects the personal information of beneficiaries and staff.

sections.heading: What we hold
sections.body: Beneficiary details received from SOCH (identifiers, name, age, sex, ART status, contact and address), the pension application entered by the Center (guardian, category, Jan Aadhaar, Aadhaar for bank linking, bank account and consent), and the accounts of authorised staff.

sections.heading: Why we hold it
sections.body: Only to process pension applications, issue Pension Payment Orders and keep payment history. The information is never used for any other purpose and is never published.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: HIV-related information is protected under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017. A beneficiary's information is processed only with their recorded consent, and is visible only to staff whose role and Center require it.

sections.heading: How it is protected
sections.body: Identifiers and bank details are encrypted in the database and shown masked in lists. Full values are revealed only to authorised verifiers, and every such view is recorded. Every action in the portal is written to a tamper-evident audit log.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Information is kept for as long as the pension record is active and then as required by the department's retention rules. Uploaded files are not kept after they are processed.

sections.heading: Questions or complaints
sections.body: Contact the RSACS helpdesk (see Helpdesk). Complaints about the handling of HIV-related information are addressed to the Complaints Officer designated under the Act.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Conditions for using the HIV Pension Portal.

sections.heading: Authorised use only
sections.body: The portal is for staff authorised by the Rajasthan State AIDS Control Society. Use it only for the work your role and Center require.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: Your User ID and password are personal. Never share them, never let another person work under your login, and never share an OTP or an authenticator code.

sections.heading: Accuracy
sections.body: Enter information exactly as shown in the beneficiary's documents. Information received from SOCH cannot be changed in the portal.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: Do not copy, photograph, print or share beneficiary information except as the pension process requires. Disclosing HIV status without authority is an offence under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017.

sections.heading: Monitoring
sections.body: Every sign-in and every action is recorded with your User ID, time and device address. Misuse may lead to suspension of access and action under the applicable laws.

sections.heading: Sessions
sections.body: You are signed out after a period of inactivity. Always sign out when you leave a shared computer.

helpdesk.title: Helpdesk
helpdesk.intro: Help with signing in and using the portal.

sections.heading: Forgot your password
sections.body: Use Forgot Password on the sign-in page. An OTP is sent to the mobile number registered with your account.

sections.heading: Account locked or role missing
sections.body: After several wrong passwords the account is locked for a short time. Your State Admin can unlock it, reset your password, or assign the right Center and role.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: RSACS helpdesk telephone and e-mail will be published here by the department. Working hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 17:00, except government holidays.

sections.heading: When you report a problem
sections.body: Say what you were doing, the time, and the reference number shown with the error message. Never send a password, an OTP or a beneficiary's details by e-mail or chat.
